description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Shield Assault
sections.description_summary: Taunts enemies within 2 tiles, reduces damage taken by 60%, and makes Antandra unaffected for 5 s. Then stuns adjacent enemies, deals damage, knocks them down and restores HP; each enemy hit adds further HP recovery.

sections.name: Shield Formation
sections.description_summary: Selects the frontmost ally (not Antandra) at battle start and grants that ally plus Antandra shields based on the ally's max HP, capped by Antandra's ATK. Re-selects if the guarded ally is defeated.

sections.name: Spear Barrage
sections.description_summary: Attacks a frontal 1-tile arc three times and reduces targets' ATK by 20% for 6 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases max HP.

sections.name: Gale Barrier
sections.description_summary: When the guarded ally first falls below 50% HP, Antandra rushes to them and reduces damage taken. LV 2 restores 100 Energy/sec to the guarded ally for 4 s.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Each enemy hit by Shield Assault increases Antandra's Phys DEF, stacking up to six times. LV 2 improves the guarded ally shield and adds healing to Antandra based on guarded ally damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening and periodic shields for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Verdant Cyclone
sections.description_summary: Pulls enemies within 2 tiles toward a selected tile, then explodes for AOE damage and immobilizes them for 3 s. Selects the tile with the most surrounding enemies.

sections.name: Ice Spike
sections.description_summary: Slashes enemies in a 3-tile arc, reducing Haste by 50 for 5 s, then stabs the target and enemies in a line behind it, reducing Magic DEF by 40% for 5 s.

sections.name: Tempest Guard
sections.description_summary: Creates a self-shield for 10 s and 50% dodge chance while active; higher level increases dodge to 80%.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Ranged DEF, with an extra amount below 50% HP.

sections.name: Howling Hurricane
sections.description_summary: Casts Verdant Cyclone once per battle without consuming Energy, at reduced damage. Higher levels improve damage and immobilize duration.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Further reduces Magic DEF on a target immobilized by Verdant Cyclone.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Adds critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Spiritual Viper
sections.description_summary: At battle start, sacrifices HP to send Darkvipers to possess enemies. Possessed enemies drop Energy when hit and lose HP over time. Active Ultimate damages all possessed enemies and can possess the nearest enemy if none are possessed.

sections.name: Soul Ravager
sections.description_summary: Drains HP from the healthiest enemy, dealing damage and healing Viperian for the damage dealt.

sections.name: Enchantment Fang
sections.description_summary: Darkvipers periodically damage possessed enemies. Active effect enhances the next bite and reduces target Energy by 60 (LV 4: 100).

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Crimson Waltz
sections.description_summary: After 10 s, if HP ratio is above 90%, burns 30% HP to damage all enemies; triggers once every 30 s.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Darkvipers return when possessed enemies are defeated, restoring HP and Energy. LV 2 enables additional possession and Life Drain.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides an opening damage and Haste bonus; higher ranks restore HP and extend the effect after assists/defeats.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Unbroken Retribution
sections.description_summary: Passive: after defeat, Athalia manifests as a lance that continues attacking with reduced ATK. Active: leaps to the enemy with highest cumulative damage and deals true damage plus a component based on recorded enemy HP loss; knocks down and is invincible while casting.

sections.name: Vengeance Charge
sections.description_summary: Targets the highest cumulative-damage enemy and dashes behind them, damaging the target and enemies in the path; invincible during dash.

sections.name: Vanguard's Renewal
sections.description_summary: Transforms into a lance and strikes adjacent enemies six times; becomes unaffected, reduces damage taken and heals during cast.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit, with extra Crit against the highest cumulative-damage enemy.

sections.name: Divine Verdict
sections.description_summary: Every second Vengeance Charge also unleashes Sacred Slashes along the two densest straight paths. LV 4 adds Execution and resets Vengeance Charge cooldown after assists/defeats.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Vengeance Charge and Sacred Slash can reduce enemy shield value, capped at 800% ATK.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Athalia's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Divine Conflagration
sections.description_summary: Flies to a designated central tile, consumes max HP and Energy over time, and fires a 5-tile flame. Damage includes a component based on Talene's lost HP, shared among hit enemies. Can continue without Energy at a higher HP cost.

sections.name: Radiant Resurgence
sections.description_summary: Passive: losing 10% max HP heals the weakest ally; restoring 10% max HP damages the healthiest enemy. Active: consumes HP to summon Divine Fire in the densest enemy area.

sections.name: Blazing Ascension
sections.description_summary: On defeat, Talene becomes an untargetable flame, regenerates HP and can benefit from allied skills; resurrects above 65% HP with an explosion and knockback. Each resurrection permanently reduces Vitality during flame state.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK based on cumulative max HP consumed.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Improves HP recovery per second during the first flame state on defeat.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Adds critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

capture_status_notes: No separate Rivalry Mode section was visible in the captured excerpt; verify before recording as absent.

sections.name: Omen's Grasp
sections.description_summary: Baden and phantoms strike one target four times; final hit deals true damage to the target and adjacent enemies, drains HP, reduces max HP, and prevents HP/Energy recovery for 8 s. Baden is invincible while casting.

capture_status_notes: Capture is truncated at Ultimate level details. Other abilities, Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode need recapture.

sections.name: Futile Echo
sections.description_summary: Passive summons an identical Illusion during preparation, inheriting 100% of Phraesto's stats and able to cast all his skills. If both are in the same row, each gains 30% damage reduction until one is defeated. Active effect damages enemies within 2 tiles and heals Phraesto per enemy hit.

sections.name: Crimson Contract
sections.description_summary: Phraesto and Illusion each contract with a different ally one tile behind them at battle start; the captured excerpt ends during this skill.

capture_status_notes: Remaining skill sections and upgrades require recapture.

sections.name: Queen's Summons
sections.description_summary: Summons Mr. Carlyle to a selected tile; he inherits Cecia's stats, gains bonus max HP that decays over time, and entangles enemies within 2 tiles, dealing damage over time and preventing movement/actions. Recasting while Carlyle is present restores him to max HP and repeats the entangle.

sections.name: Earth's Offering
sections.description_summary: The excerpt shows an ATK SPD increase and an extra ATK SPD increase while Mr. Carlyle is on the battlefield; the complete ability text was not returned.

sections.name: Trial of Thorns
sections.description_summary: Entangles an enemy, deals damage over time and prevents movement/actions; Cecia absorbs Phys DEF and Magic DEF from the target and shares stolen stats with Mr. Carlyle.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Reduces the normal-attack requirement for Agonizing Puncture. LV 2 grants 500 Initial Energy and permanent stat stealing from entangled enemies when casting Ultimate, shared with Mr. Carlyle.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

capture_status_notes: Earth's Offering is only partially described in the returned excerpt; keep this profile partial until the full section is recaptured.

sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.
